backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing an e-commerce system with product catalog (12 hardcoded Indian grocery items), shopping cart management per user principal, and order placement functionality with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds an orders list to the actor state while preserving existing products and carts data structures during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting six implemented features for checkout flow, admin orders dashboard, and React Query hooks with high confidence ratings and test IDs REQ-21 through REQ-26.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 15 frontend files describing the complete React application structure including routing, components, pages, hooks, and styling for the Swapan Store e-commerce platform.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode themes using warm, earthy tones inspired by Indian spice markets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'Swapan Store' title, and script reference to main.tsx module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with five routes (products, cart, checkout, admin, admin login) wrapped in QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers with shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright notice and 'Built with ❤️ using caffeine.ai' attribution with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with Swapan Store branding, navigation links to Products and Admin pages, and shopping cart button displaying total item count badge.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: React component that displays a product card with image, details, price, quantity selector, and add-to-cart functionality using mutations and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating anonymous or authenticated actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Custom hook that manages admin authentication state using sessionStorage, providing login/logout functions and persisting authentication across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including fetching products/cart/orders, adding to cart, updating prices, verifying admin password, and placing orders with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm Indian spice market color palette for both light and dark modes using HSL color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays products with inline price editing, shows all orders sorted by timestamp, maps backend image URLs to local assets, and includes authentication checks with logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with password verification form that authenticates users via backend mutation and redirects to dashboard on success using session-based auth.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page component that displays cart items with local image mapping, calculates totals, and provides navigation to checkout or back to products.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component with phone number and address input fields, order summary display, and order placement functionality with validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Main products listing page with hero banner, category filtering tabs, and product grid display using local image mapping for product assets.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrice.ts: Utility function that formats numeric price values to Indian Rupee format with ₹ symbol prefix and two decimal places.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended typography, container queries, animations, and warm shadow utilities for Indian spice market aesthetic.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking implemented features including product listing, shopping cart, admin dashboard, authentication, checkout flow, and design system for Swapan Store e-commerce application.
